title: U-King MiniApp Registry Feed
description: The shape of a mini-app market feed. A registry is just a static JSON file on any HTTPS host — there is no central authority, and U-King can be pointed at several. Entries are advertisements, not truth: the host re-validates the downloaded package against uking-app.schema.json before installing anything.

name.description: Display name of this registry, e.g. U-King 官方小程序市场.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last rebuild.

download.description: URL of the .ukapp (tar.gz). Plain HTTP is rejected by the host.

sha256.description: Digest of the .ukapp. The host verifies it before unpacking; a mismatch aborts the install.

permissions_summary.description: Human-readable permission list shown BEFORE download, so the user is not asked to consent after the bytes are already on disk.

actions.description: Action IDs this app contributes. Lets an agent search the market by capability instead of by name.

yanked_reason.description: Set when a version must not be installed any more (security). The host hides it and warns anyone who already has it.
